errors.text_span: wobei die Tick-Abstände jedes Jahr entsprechen
errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are spaced every two years (2000, 2002, 2004, etc.), not every year.
The y-axis range shown in the plot is from 0.75 to 1.05. The description incorrectly uses the minimum and a peak data value as the axis range.

errors.text_span: wobei die Werte in einer logarithmischen Skala angegeben sind
errors.evidence: The y-axis has evenly spaced intervals (0.05 units), indicating a linear scale, not a logarithmic one.

errors.text_span: und sinkt dann im Laufe der Zeit
errors.evidence: This oversimplifies the trend. The line fluctuates significantly between 2000 and 2015, with several peaks and troughs, before it begins a more consistent decline. It does not simply sink after the start.

errors.text_span: Sie erreicht im Jahr 2002 einen Höchstwert von 0,97
errors.evidence: The chart shows the value in 2002 is 1.00, not 0.97. This was one of the peaks in the observed period.
The value in 2008 is approximately 0.98. The line does not dip to 0.95 until 2009.
The value in 2014 is approximately 0.96. The value 0.97 is explicitly labeled above the data point for 2015.
The value in 2018 is visibly below the 0.95 gridline, at approximately 0.94.
